verdicts.reason: A is a shrunk portrait column in a wide canvas: the teal circle has come away from the headphones and sits alone at the right, the divider runs only on the right, the two stat columns are pushed far apart across a big empty gap, and the logo, subhead, stat labels and legal text are tiny. B has a strong left column (logo, headphones, large headline), but the right half is a mess: the stats are out of order and at random sizes (10 min is huge, the others small), 250 g and 6 mics sit on the leftover circle, the subhead floats at the top, and the legal text is as large as the copy next to a small CTA. B is still more readable and more intentional overall.
